bifrost: No call framework. Adjacent: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs, springboard/audiod/src/
summary: BifrOSt has no VoIP, telephony or call-UI code. Only notifications and audio exist as building blocks; a calling feature would need its own API.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no call provider registration

Each ringing call gets a banner or full-screen card with answer and decline, and CardStack keeps the oldest ringing card on screen with the rest waiting, pruned against the call controller; tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-35.rs. Gap: no shell surface draws the card or sends its requests yet, so the card is not shown on a device.
